name: JudgeBench-Pro
description: JudgeBench-Pro is an extended and more challenging benchmark for evaluating the robustness of LLM-as-a-judge systems. It is designed to automatically and systematically discover potential biases in model evaluation, improving the reliability and robustness of LLM-based evaluation.
reputation: A very recent benchmark for evaluating LLM-as-a-judge robustness, with emerging interest but limited community adoption so far.
notes: Automates bias discovery in LLM evaluation; shows high error rates in LLM evaluators, highlighting evaluation robustness challenges.
